test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

The science or art of political government
solution: The correct answer is** "Politics".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ ** Let's look at the meanings of the given words: __ • Politics means "the work and ideas that are connected with governing a country, a town, etc. (**ऐसे कार्य और अभिमत जिनका संबंध किसी देश का शासन चलाने से हो; राजनीति**)**".** • ​Example: *Foreign domination had a malign influence on local **politics.*** • From the above explanation, it can be concluded that 'Politics' is the correct word to substitute for the given description. Hence, option 1 is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ ** • **Sociology **means the study of human societies and social behaviour (**समाजशास्‍त्र; मानव समाजों और सामाजिक व्‍यवहार का अध्ययन**). • **Economics **means the study or principles of the way money, business and industry are organized (**मुद्रा, व्‍यवसाय और उद्योग की संगठन रीतियों के सिद्घांतों का अध्ययन; अर्थशास्‍त्र**). • **Theology **means the study of religion (**धर्म का अध्ययन; धर्मशास्‍त्र**). 41:Tcbd, The correct answer is **"Prominent".**
